title: Miami Private Boat Rental with Champagne, Sandbars & Floating Mat
includes: CAPTAIN SURCHARGE- $50 Per Hour (Paid at dock, Government charge agreement for private boats w/USCG) (not included)
Gratuity up to your discretion! (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please refer to exclusions for payable fees at dock.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Have fun on this amusing 30' Sea Ray Sundeck equipped with Bluetooth speakers on deck, showers and bathroom on board!
 Enjoy the sightseeing around Miami Bay, Miami Skyline from Miami River and through all surrounding islands including Start Island, Venetian Islands (famous mansions view) and last but not least come and swim in private Sister's sandbars, or around the beautiful Flagler Monument Island and get entertained on our large floating mat!!

 Refresh yourself with a cold drink! Get amused with our Miami Sunsets and city night lights view!

We provide a cooler with ice and bottled water for your convenience, You are welcome to bring your favorite drinks and food aboard! 

HOOKAH AND RED WINE ARE NOT ALLOWED. 

Come and have fun at the sea!!

 Please refer to our exclusions for payable fees at dock.
